propositions: Focused prerequisite consistency criterion must evaluate each direct dependency independently without injecting prerequisite material into general reviewers or changing parent/child review behavior
Prerequisite-scoped findings require a new canonical structured identity encoding (length-prefixed UTF-8 fields with SHA-256) distinct from legacy pipe-delimited non-prerequisite IDs
Focused Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier use separate non-overlapping index domains that reshape independently before single shared Pass-3 execution-review pipeline
Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while retaining DET blockers visibly in the blocking array

Singleton focused finder must achieve ≥0.90 recall and ≤0.10 false-acceptance rate with 1.00 coverage and 0.00 attribution error before packed implementation; packed results must not regress against pinned singleton baseline

Context-limit failures on focused finder/verifier calls trigger recursive bin splitting (never splitting subject or prerequisite plan text) or model escalation, ultimately emitting indeterminate/evaluation-error with detail=input-too-large
